sourceRoot: Directory containing index.ts, config.ts, tokens.css, components.css and ai/. All paths in this registry resolve from that directory; preserve ai/ when relocating it.

fields.name: radius
fields.note: Pixels. No runtime validation/clamp; use a finite nonnegative value. 0–16 is the workbench range, not a type/API restriction.

fields.name: reducedMotion
fields.note: true additionally reduces motion; false never overrides OS prefers-reduced-motion.

components.purpose: Compact composable navigation surface with expanded and icon rail states.
components.useWhen: Persistent desktop navigation or the same content composed inside an existing Sheet on mobile.
components.alternative: Use native links for destinations, SidebarAction for commands and SidebarDisclosure for one level of children. Sheet supplies mobile modality.
components.inheritedProps: Sidebar accepts native aside props/ref. SidebarHeader/Footer native div, SidebarContent native nav (supply aria-label), SidebarLabel native span. SidebarGroup native div plus optional heading:string. SidebarItem native anchor excluding children plus required label:string, icon:ReactNode, optional count:string|number, active:boolean=false; real href supplied by caller. SidebarAction native button excluding children plus label, icon, count. SidebarToggle native button plus required collapseLabel/expandLabel strings. SidebarDisclosure native button excluding children plus required label/icon/children, optional count, activeChild=false, open/defaultOpen=false/onOpenChange. All native attributes/events/ref/className/style remain on the underlying element. Buttons default type=button. Preventing default in click cancels built-in toggle/disclosure behavior.
components.state: collapsed/onCollapsedChange controls root; omission initializes internal state from defaultCollapsed once. Disclosure open/onOpenChange or internal defaultOpen. Rail disclosure requests root expansion and opens children. Both controlled callbacks must update caller state. Previously open children reappear when root expands. activeChild is explicit caller state, not inferred from routing or DOM.
accessibility: Native links preserve browser destination/modifier behavior; required label supplies accessible name independent of hidden text. Counts and icons are decorative; include essential count meaning in an explicit aria-label if needed. Existing Tooltip supplies rail labels.

Collapse/disclosure hides children with hidden/inert. Focus moves from hidden descendants to their disclosure parent, otherwise a visible toggle/item. Wrap slot text in SidebarLabel; hidden labels are inert. Keep essential actions as SidebarAction.

Logical indentation and chevrons mirror direction. Header/footer persist while SidebarContent scrolls; host supplies bounded height and inline-start placement. Both OS and application reduced motion suppress transitions.
Reuse the same content in Sheet on mobile. Keep trigger mounted; hand destination focus after trigger restoration. Escape/outside dismissal restores trigger.
limitations: One disclosure level supported. No routing, permission, workspace switching, shell, mobile overlay or persistence framework.
Give every interactive rail item an icon. Host positions Sidebar on the right for RTL, left for LTR. Header/footer are arbitrary composition slots; use SidebarLabel to hide text.
Counts truncate visually and do not convey essential meaning on their own.

components.purpose: Perform an explicit action.
components.useWhen: Save, submit, create, or open an overlay.
components.alternative: Use Switch for a persistent boolean setting; Tabs for related views.

props.name: state
props.note: Caller-owned state; no automatic loading/feedback lifecycle. Loading disables activation and sets aria-busy; success/error do not disable the button.

props.name: iconOnly
props.note: When true, aria-label is required by ButtonProps; provide a nonempty accessible name.

props.name: aria-label
props.note: Required when iconOnly=true, optional otherwise. Not forwarded via the ordinary inherited base; reintroduced by the conditional union.

props.name: children
props.note: Visible meaningful action label, or one decorative icon in iconOnly idle state. State icons replace icon-only children outside idle.

components.inheritedProps: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> except aria-label, which is reintroduced conditionally. Native form attributes, id, style, event handlers, ARIA/data attributes are accepted; className is appended. No ref prop in ButtonProps.
exclusions: No asChild or href/link API. Caller aria-busy is overridden by state; internal data-state/data-variant/data-size and className are owned by the wrapper.
components.state: state is fully caller-controlled; disabled is also forced while loading.
events: onClick and native button events; connect actions to application logic.
accessibility: Icon-only needs aria-label. Use descriptive visible text otherwise. Decorative icons should be aria-hidden. Set type=submit explicitly for submission.
limitations: No built-in async operation, persistence, retry or automatic transition back to idle.
providers: SystemProvider for styling/configuration; Button itself reads CSS tokens.

components.inheritedProps: None beyond the three provider props. ToastMessage controls individual notices.
exclusions: No public Toast component, open/onOpenChange, provider duration prop, arbitrary Radix attrs or action slot.
components.state: useToast().toast(message) adds an internally managed notice; automatic/manual dismissal. At most three active messages; older active messages are dropped, not queued indefinitely.
events: toast(message): void; message fields described in records.

An active Toast participates in Radix dismissable-layer ordering: Escape can dismiss it before a Sheet even when focus is inside the Sheet. Check layer dismissal and restoration separately.
providers: SystemProvider for styling/config; ToastProvider for useToast callers.

Native attributes/events/form, external ARIA descriptions, className/style and React 19 ref stay on the input in both modes. label/helper/error convenience mode cannot be combined with field; without label, helper/error are not accepted.

components.state: value/onChange controls; defaultValue initializes native uncontrolled value. Native reset restores uncontrolled default; controlled reset needs host onReset. Input is the normal starting point for text entry. With label, internal Field supplies stable label/helper/error associations and required indicator. Error text marks invalid; validation remains application-owned. Field is available for explicit lower-level composition.

events: onValueChange(string), including uncancelled reset request after event dispatch; native trigger button events.
accessibility: Radix arrows/Home/End/typeahead/Enter/Space/Escape and trigger restoration; disabled options skipped. Name with Field or external label/ARIA. Static checkValidity never moves focus. Interactive native focus redirects hidden select to visible trigger; ancestor invalid cancellation and application summary focus are respected.
limitations: Unique nonempty option values and meaningful string labels are caller requirements. Native hidden select supports submission/reset/required; application owns validation rules/messages. onInvalid on trigger does not expose hidden select event. Popup fades without moving hit targets and scrolls within available viewport.

components.purpose: Choose a single predefined form value.
components.useWhen: Customer status or another finite single choice.
components.alternative: Input for free text; DropdownMenu for commands.
components.inheritedProps: ComponentPropsWithRef<button> except children/value/defaultValue/onChange/type, plus explicit SelectProps. Native trigger style/ARIA/data/events are supported; ref targets trigger. name/form/autoComplete target Radix native select.
exclusions: No search, multi-select, controlled open, defaultOpen, custom popup/positioning or children slots.
components.state: Radix Select 2.4.1 is internally controlled by Tiraz: public value/onValueChange or local state initialized by defaultValue. Successful form reset requests the initial value after event dispatch; controlled owner must accept callback. Cancelled onReset/onResetCapture preserves state and emits no reset change, including external form association. Reset resolves the current native form at dispatch, supporting late form insertion and same-ID replacement without remounting Select. Replacement preserves selection; former form reset is ignored. Empty string denotes placeholder.

components.purpose: Display a small native HTML table.
components.useWhen: Read-only tabular records such as customer name, email and status.
components.alternative: Plain content for non-tabular information. Advanced data-grid interactions are outside this foundation.
components.inheritedProps: ComponentPropsWithRef<table>. Native attributes, events, className/style and ref target the table. containerProps is separate native div attributes/ref; retain tabIndex=0 for keyboard scroll. TableHeader/TableBody/TableRow/TableHead/TableCell accept native thead/tbody/tr/th/td props and refs. TableHead defaults scope to col, override with row when appropriate.
events: Native table and element events; no data operations.
accessibility: Native caption names the table and scroll region. Without caption, supply aria-label or aria-labelledby. Default container tabIndex=0 enables keyboard horizontal scroll. Native headers/scope, colSpan and headers remain available; isolate mixed-direction cell content with bdi.
limitations: No sorting, filtering, pagination, selection, editing, virtualization or sticky columns. Data, stable unique row keys and empty content are application-owned. The table has a 32rem minimum width and wraps cells; narrow layouts scroll inside the container.
providers: SystemProvider supplies tokens, density, typography, theme and direction.

props.note: Application-filtered records. Supply [] for loading/error.

props.note: Unique IDs; header, cell, optional sortValue and rowHeader.

props.note: Stable unique row keys; never use array positions.

props.name: pageSize
props.note: Positive integer; floors fractions, clamps below 1 to 1; nonfinite values use 10.

props.name: resetKey
props.note: Change with application filters, even when the result count stays equal. Sort resets internally. Data shrink permanently clamps current page.

props.name: loading
props.note: Sets table aria-busy; disables pagination. Does not fetch data.

behavior: One internal sorting/pagination mode, default 10 rows; no selection, bulk actions, editing, deletion, virtualization, sticky columns or server framework.

accessibility: Named region and plot, visible summary, optional semantic table. Recharts accessibilityLayer supports Tab then arrows. VoiceOver needs QuickNav off; manual screen-reader validation remains unverified.
limitations: No chart engine, stacking, configuration framework or fetching.
Cartesian data is kept in input order even in RTL. category is reserved and ISO dates use UTC. Missing/nonfinite values remain gaps.
Donut plots positive finite values; zero/missing/negative entries remain in the optional table.
Palette has four distinguishable defaults; supply deliberate CSS colors beyond four series. Comparable charts must reuse series order and explicit colors.
Drawing and tooltip-position animations are disabled. CSS interactions use motion tokens and honor OS/system reduction.

components.purpose: Restrained Recharts rendering with Tiraz tokens, shared tooltip, optional legend/table.
components.inheritedProps: No additional native or Recharts props. className/style stay on the named region.
components.state: Legend visibility is internal and keyed by stable unique keys. All hidden is an explicit state; table retains all source values. When interactive legend controls are unavailable, all series are visible; hidden keys are retained for their return.

props.name: duration
props.note: Milliseconds. Supply a positive finite duration. No Tiraz clamp; 1000–60000 is only the workbench editing range.

props.name: resultCount
props.type: (from: number, to: number, total: number) => string

props.name: config
props.note: When supplied, full required config fields are needed; partial overrides are not merged. Use {...defaultConfig, ...overrides}.

support.purpose: Scope tokens, direction and portal container; accepts no other wrapper attributes. Set lang on a host ancestor above the provider/document so all scoped overlays and notices inherit it.
Typed shared settings, Arabic/compact defaults and paired light/dark accent values; configuration.fields is authoritative metadata.
Returns {config, container: HTMLDivElement | null}. Outside a provider returns defaultConfig/null; CSS styling is not installed automatically. SystemContext is internal, not a barrel export.
Provider props and lifecycle are documented by the toast family.
Returns {toast(message: ToastMessage): void}; use within ToastProvider or it throws. ToastContext is internal, not a barrel export; ToastMessage fields are in records.

Sidebar accepts native aside props/ref. SidebarHeader/Footer native div, SidebarContent native nav (supply aria-label), SidebarLabel native span. SidebarGroup native div plus optional heading:string. SidebarItem native anchor excluding children plus required label:string, icon:ReactNode, optional count:string|number, active:boolean=false; real href supplied by caller. SidebarAction native button excluding children plus label, icon, count. SidebarToggle native button plus required collapseLabel/expandLabel strings. SidebarDisclosure native button excluding children plus required label/icon/children, optional count, activeChild=false, open/defaultOpen=false/onOpenChange. All native attributes/events/ref/className/style remain on the underlying element. Buttons default type=button. Preventing default in click cancels built-in toggle/disclosure behavior.

conventions.defaults: Default fields contain literal JSON scalars or descriptive expressions. The string undefined means omitted/no default, not a string value to pass. configuration.defaults contains the actual literal defaultConfig.
conventions.authority: Public source/types win; inherited prop details depend on the installed React/Radix versions. Workbench editing limits are not public API limits.
conventions.overlayDependencies: Use one resolved @radix-ui/react-dismissable-layer 1.2.1 and @radix-ui/react-focus-scope 1.3.1; source-copy hosts preserve overrides from ai/README.md. @radix-ui/react-popper 1.4.0 supplies Tooltip positioning.
conventions.chartDependencies: Verified Recharts 3.10.1, React/React DOM 19.3.0 and react-is 19.3.0. Use a matching react-is version in source-copy hosts.
